name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-pre-release-lakitu
title: Super Mario World (Pre-release) – Lakitu
description:
An early version of Lakitu.

This is meant to be used with the SMB3 Lakitu.

You must change the cloud's palette by editing the ASM file (lakitu_smb3.asm). Locate the line:
;Cloud palette
!CloudPal = $02
Then, change $02 to $0B , so it looks like this:
!CloudPal = $0B

Credit is optional.
